config.yml:
log:
  stdout: true
  level: info
persistence:
  defaultStore: default
  visibilityStore: visibility
  numHistoryShards: 4
  datastores:
    default:
      sql:
        pluginName: postgres12
        databaseName: temporal
        connectAddr: "temporal-postgres:5432"
        connectProtocol: tcp
        user: "temporal"
        password: "__RUNTIME_PASSWORD__"
        maxConns: 20
        maxIdleConns: 20
        maxConnLifetime: 1h
    visibility:
      sql:
        pluginName: postgres12
        databaseName: temporal_visibility
        connectAddr: "temporal-postgres:5432"
        connectProtocol: tcp
        user: "temporal"
        password: "__RUNTIME_PASSWORD__"
        maxConns: 2
        maxIdleConns: 2
        maxConnLifetime: 1h
global:
  membership:
    maxJoinDuration: 30s
    broadcastAddress: 127.0.0.1
  tls:
    internode:
      server:
        certFile: /tls/server.pem
        keyFile: /tls/server.key
        requireClientAuth: true
        clientCaFiles: [/tls/ca.pem]
      client:
        serverName: "temporal-server"
        rootCaFiles: [/tls/ca.pem]
    frontend:
      server:
        certFile: /tls/server.pem
        keyFile: /tls/server.key
        requireClientAuth: true
        clientCaFiles: [/tls/ca.pem]
      client:
        serverName: "temporal-server"
        rootCaFiles: [/tls/ca.pem]
    systemWorker:
      certFile: /tls/client.pem
      keyFile: /tls/client.key
      client:
        serverName: "temporal-server"
        rootCaFiles: [/tls/ca.pem]
services:
  frontend:
    rpc:
      grpcPort: 7233
      membershipPort: 6933
      bindOnIP: 0.0.0.0
  history:
    rpc:
      grpcPort: 7234
      membershipPort: 6934
      bindOnLocalHost: true
  matching:
    rpc:
      grpcPort: 7235
      membershipPort: 6935
      bindOnLocalHost: true
  worker:
    rpc:
      grpcPort: 7239
      membershipPort: 6939
      bindOnLocalHost: true
clusterMetadata:
  enableGlobalNamespace: false
  failoverVersionIncrement: 10
  masterClusterName: active
  currentClusterName: active
  clusterInformation:
    active:
      enabled: true
      initialFailoverVersion: 1
      rpcName: frontend
      rpcAddress: 127.0.0.1:7233
dcRedirectionPolicy:
  policy: noop
archival:
  history: {state: disabled, enableRead: false}
  visibility: {state: disabled, enableRead: false}
namespaceDefaults:
  archival:
    history: {state: disabled}
    visibility: {state: disabled}
dynamicConfigClient:
  filepath: /dynamic.yml
  pollInterval: 10s
docker.service:
[Unit]
Description=Docker Application Container Engine (Rootless)
Documentation=https://docs.docker.com/go/rootless/
Requires=dbus.socket
StartLimitBurst=3
StartLimitIntervalSec=60s

[Service]
Environment=PATH=/usr/bin:/usr/sbin:/bin:/sbin
Environment=DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_NET=pasta
Environment=DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_PORT_DRIVER=implicit
Environment=DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_DISABLE_HOST_LOOPBACK=true
ExecStart=/usr/bin/dockerd-rootless.sh
ExecReload=/bin/kill -s HUP $MAINPID
TimeoutSec=0
RestartSec=2
Restart=always
LimitNOFILE=infinity
LimitNPROC=infinity
LimitCORE=infinity
TasksMax=infinity
Delegate=yes
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=all
KillMode=mixed

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
frontend-tailnet.service:
[Unit]
Description=Temporal frontend on the tailnet (TCP passthrough)
Requires=tailscaled.service
After=tailscaled.service network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/bin/env tailscale serve --bg --service=svc:temporal-frontend --tcp=7233 tcp://127.0.0.1:7233
ExecStop=/usr/bin/env tailscale serve --service=svc:temporal-frontend --tcp=7233 off

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
postgres-start:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
ulimit -c 0
export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/1000/docker.sock
docker rm -f temporal-postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker run -d --name temporal-postgres --network temporal \
  --tmpfs /run/secrets:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=1m \
  --mount type=bind,src=/var/lib/temporal/postgres,dst=/var/lib/postgresql/data \
  --mount type=bind,src=/var/lib/temporal/.config/temporal-postgres/init.sh,dst=/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sh,readonly \
  --env POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/admin-password \
  --entrypoint /bin/bash 'postgres@sha256:9e2cf6287f25c3151f4c9421ccce2b17f3e60061c111a29165e0d2cdd9ff0a97' \
  -c 'until test -e /run/secrets/ready; do sleep 0.1; done; exec docker-entrypoint.sh postgres -c max_connections=100' >/dev/null
docker exec -i temporal-postgres sh -c 'umask 077; cat > /run/secrets/admin-password' < /etc/temporal-host/postgres-admin-password
docker exec -i temporal-postgres sh -c 'umask 077; cat > /run/secrets/login-password' < /etc/temporal-host/postgres-password
docker exec temporal-postgres chmod 0444 /run/secrets/admin-password /run/secrets/login-password
docker exec temporal-postgres touch /run/secrets/ready
for _attempt in {1..120}; do
  if docker exec temporal-postgres pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres >/dev/null; then
    docker exec temporal-postgres rm /run/secrets/admin-password /run/secrets/login-password
    systemd-notify --ready
    exit_code=$(docker wait temporal-postgres)
    exit "$exit_code"
  fi
  sleep 1
done
exit 1
postgres.service:
[Unit]
Description=Temporal PostgreSQL
Requires=docker.service
After=docker.service

[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=all
ExecStart=%h/.local/bin/temporal-postgres-start
ExecStop=/usr/bin/docker stop --time 30 temporal-postgres
ExecStopPost=-/usr/bin/docker rm -f temporal-postgres
Environment=DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/1000/docker.sock
TimeoutStartSec=240
TimeoutStopSec=60
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
server-start:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
config="$HOME/.config/temporal-server"
runtime="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/temporal-server"
password_file=/etc/temporal-host/postgres-password
admin='temporalio/admin-tools:1.32.0@sha256:a9f84fb9a374b2374fe2e67c8efc0468ff3f1c66c8a0b14597ec86e349e62bca'
server='temporalio/server:1.32.0@sha256:c3e752127759616bb1615e0f9ba0e21635aeb5fdeb922de4f371c350955f46ae'
network=temporal
postgres_host=temporal-postgres
postgres_user=temporal
docker image inspect "$admin" >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker pull "$admin"
docker image inspect "$server" >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker pull "$server"
for database in temporal temporal_visibility; do
  schema=temporal
  if [[ $database == temporal_visibility ]]; then schema=visibility; fi
  migration=$(cat "$password_file" | docker run --rm -i --user 0 --network "$network" \
    --entrypoint /bin/sh "$admin" -ec '
      SQL_PASSWORD=$(cat)
      export SQL_PASSWORD
      temporal-sql-tool --plugin postgres12 --ep "$1" -p 5432 -u "$2" --db "$3" setup-schema -v 0.0
      temporal-sql-tool --plugin postgres12 --ep "$1" -p 5432 -u "$2" --db "$3" update-schema -d "/etc/temporal/schema/postgresql/v12/$4/versioned"
      expected=$(find "/etc/temporal/schema/postgresql/v12/$4/versioned" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | sed '"'"'s|.*/v||'"'"' | sort -V | tail -n 1)
      printf "expected-schema=%s\n" "$expected"
    ' sh "$postgres_host" "$postgres_user" "$database" "$schema")
  expected=$(printf "%s\n" "$migration" | sed -n "s/^expected-schema=//p")
  actual=$(docker exec temporal-postgres psql -U "$postgres_user" -d "$database" -Atc "SELECT curr_version FROM schema_version")
  test "$actual" = "$expected"
done
echo 'Temporal schema migrations complete; starting server 1.32.0'
python3 - "$config/config.yml" "$password_file" "$runtime/docker.yaml" <<'PYTHON'
import json
import pathlib
import sys
source, secret, target = map(pathlib.Path, sys.argv[1:])
target.write_text(source.read_text().replace('"__RUNTIME_PASSWORD__"', json.dumps(secret.read_text().rstrip("\n"))))
PYTHON
exec docker run --rm --name temporal-server --user 0 --network "$network" \
  --publish 127.0.0.1:7233:7233 \
  --mount "type=bind,src=$runtime,dst=/runtime,readonly" \
  --mount "type=bind,src=$config/tls,dst=/tls,readonly" \
  --mount "type=bind,src=$config/dynamic.yml,dst=/dynamic.yml,readonly" \
  --entrypoint temporal-server "$server" --root / --config runtime --env docker start \
  --service frontend --service history --service matching --service worker
server.service:
[Unit]
Description=Temporal server with schema migration before startup
Requires=docker.service
After=docker.service

[Service]

ExecStart=%h/.local/bin/temporal-server-start
ExecStop=-/usr/bin/docker stop --time 30 temporal-server
ExecStopPost=-/usr/bin/docker rm --force temporal-server
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
TimeoutStartSec=900
TimeoutStopSec=60
